selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 武器药膏的非伤害性效果提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the non-damaging effects of your weapon poisons by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 切割激活时，每3秒为你恢复最多1%的最大生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Slice and Dice heals you for up to 1% of your maximum health per 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使目标失明并迷惑地乱转，持续1分钟。任何伤害都可能打断此效果。只能对一个目标使用。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 1 min. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 从30秒内的下一次伤害性攻击开始， [偷天换日: 使目标的伤害提高15%，并将你产生的所有威胁值转移 / 将你产生的所有威胁值转移]给选中的小队或团队成员，持续6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: [Thick as Thieves: Increases the target's damage by 15%, and redirects / Redirects] all threat you cause to the targeted party or raid member, beginning with your next damaging attack within the next 30 sec and lasting 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使疾跑的冷却时间缩短60秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Sprint by 60 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂徒
抓钩可以额外使用1次。

 奇袭,  敏锐
暗影步可以额外使用1次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Outlaw
Grappling Hook has 1 additional charge.

 Assassination,  Subtlety
Shadowstep has 1 additional charge.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 提供短暂的魔法免疫，并立即移除所有的有害法术效果。斗篷激活期间，抵抗所有有害法术效果，持续5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使用你的 [强化毒刃: 淬毒利刃 / 副手]进行攻击，造成([125.4% of Attack Power])%点物理伤害，驱散所有激怒效果，并对目标施放浓缩形态的激活的非致命药膏。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Attack with your [Improved Shiv: poisoned blades / off-hand], dealing (125.4% of Attack Power)% Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 闪避还会使受到的伤害降低20%。佯攻还会使受到的非范围类伤害降低20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你产生连击点数的攻击的爆击几率提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the critical strike chance of your attacks that generate combo points by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你从猩红之瓶、治疗药水和治疗石获得的治疗效果提高25%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the healing you receive from Crimson Vial, healing potions, and healthstones by 25%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 佯攻和猩红之瓶的能量消耗降低10点。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Energy cost of Feint and Crimson Vial reduced by 10.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 敏捷提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your Agility by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的武器药膏的伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 产生连击点的攻击爆击时，会使你下一个终结技的爆击几率提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Critically striking with an attack that generates combo points increases the critical strike chance of your next finishing move by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 爆击几率提高1%。生成连击点数的攻击的爆击伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Critical strike chance increased by 1%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
连击点数的上限额外提高1点。

消耗5点连击点数以上的终结技产生的效果得以加强，并且终结技造成的伤害提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Gain 1 additional max combo point.

Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 急速提高1.5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Haste increased by 1.5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 切割使攻击速度额外提高，数值相当于你的急速的100%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Slice and Dice grants additional attack speed equal to 100% of your Haste.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 佯攻可以额外使用1次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Feint has 1 additional charge.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复100点能量。

当能量低于30点时，喝下一杯蓟叶茶。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Restore 100 Energy.

When your Energy is reduced below 30, drink a Thistle Tea.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 为你的致命药膏添加吸血效果，使你的吸血提高3.0%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Adds a Leeching effect to your Lethal poisons, granting you 3.0% Leech.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你的能量值上限提高50点，能量回复加快5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your maximum Energy by 50 and Energy regeneration by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你有20%的几率部分闪避任何对你造成的伤害，使其造成的伤害降低20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: You have a 20% chance to partially evade any damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 躲闪几率提高100%，持续10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使用非致命药膏给你的武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，使其造成的伤害降低( - 4 *- 1)%，持续1分钟。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing their damage by ( - 4 *- 1)% for 1 min.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 移动速度提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Movement speed increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的终结技造成的伤害提高6%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your finishing moves deal 6% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 终结技的能量消耗降低6%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Energy cost of finishing moves reduced by 6%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 致盲的冷却时间缩短50%，持续时间缩短70%，并会对周围的所有敌人生效。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Blind has 50% reduced cooldown, 70% reduced duration, and applies to all nearby enemies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 受到的物理伤害降低5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Physical damage taken reduced by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 毒刃的能量消耗降低20点，冷却时间缩短15秒，射程增加3码。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Shiv's Energy cost is reduced by 20, its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec, and its range is increased by 3 yds.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 根据目标身上已有的同类效果数量，你的武器药膏、自然伤害或流血持续伤害效果对目标造成的伤害提高1%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your weapon poisons and Nature or Bleed damage over time abilities deal 1% increased damage to targets for each of your lethal poison or damage over time effects on them.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 锁喉造成的伤害提高50%。在潜行状态下及脱离潜行状态后6秒内施放锁喉没有冷却。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Garrote deals 50% increased damage and has no cooldown when used from Stealth and for 6 sec after breaking Stealth.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 死亡印记激活时，你造成的所有伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: All damage you deal is increased by 10% while Deathmark is active.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 能量回复速度提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your Energy regeneration by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 刀扇的爆击几率提高5%，爆击时必定施加你的武器药膏效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Fan of Knives has 5% increased critical strike chance and its critical strikes always apply your weapon poisons.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 锁喉和割裂的伤害提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Garrote and Rupture damage increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 爆击几率提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases Critical Strike chance by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 产生连击点数的攻击造成爆击时，每次爆击额外获得一个连击点数。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Critical strikes with attacks that generate combo points grant an additional combo point per critical strike.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 毒伤效果使毒伤的伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Envenom's effect increases the damage of Envenom by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在已激活毒伤时再次施加毒伤，除去提升你的施毒几率以外，还会使你造成的所有伤害提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Applying Envenom while Envenom is already active causes it to increase all damage you deal by 5% in addition to increasing your poison application chance.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
锁喉和割裂每次对受到你的涂毒武器影响的目标造成流血伤害时，都可以为你恢复3点能量。在首次造成流血伤害后，每次恢复的能量会衰减。

如果一名敌人在受到你的割裂影响时死亡，你将根据敌人身上割裂剩余的持续时间恢复能量。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
You regain 3 Energy each time your Garrote or Rupture deal Bleed damage to a target affected by your weapon poisons. Energy gain is reduced for bleeds beyond the first.

If an enemy dies while afflicted by your Rupture, you regain energy based on its remaining duration.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
在一个敌人身上刻下死亡印记，在16秒内造成([320% of Attack Power])点流血伤害，并为你恢复80点能量。你对目标施放的锁喉、割裂和致命药膏造成的伤害提高75%。

每当你对目标施加致命药膏时，会额外施加一次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Carve a deathmark into an enemy, dealing (320% of Attack Power) Bleed damage and restoring 80 Energy to you over 16 sec. Damage dealt to the target by your Garrote, Rupture, and Lethal Poisons is increased by 75%.

Each time you apply a Lethal Poison to the target, apply it twice.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
释放你武器中的强力毒素并注入目标体内，立即对其造成([146.9% of Attack Power])点自然伤害，并使其在14秒内额外受到([203% of Attack Power])点自然伤害。

每当你的致命药膏击中受到君王之灾影响的目标时，君王之灾造成的伤害提高20%，最多提高1000%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Release a powerful poison from your weapons and inject it into your target, dealing (146.9% of Attack Power) Nature damage instantly and an additional (203% of Attack Power) Nature damage over 14 sec. 

Each time you apply a Lethal Poison to a target affected by Kingsbane, Kingsbane damage increases by 20%, up to 1000%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使用致命药膏给你的武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，造成([8.14% of Attack Power])点自然伤害并施加增效药膏，持续12秒。毒伤可以消耗10层增效药膏，造成的伤害提高35%。最多20层。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy, dealing (8.14% of Attack Power) Nature damage and applying Amplifying Poison for 12 sec. Envenom can consume 10 stacks of Amplifying Poison to deal 35% increased damage. Max 20 stacks.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的武器药膏的伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每个受到你的割裂影响的敌人都会使你的敏捷提高2%，最高可达20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Each enemy afflicted by your Rupture increases your Agility by 2%, up to a maximum of 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 锁喉的伤害提高30%。在潜行状态下使用的锁喉额外产生2个连击点数。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Garrote damage increased by 30%. Garrote generates 2 additional combo points when used from Stealth.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
毒伤或君王之灾会施加腐蚀飞溅，持续10秒。仅能对1个目标施加。

腐蚀飞溅使你造成的20%自然伤害溅射给附近其他敌人，目标超过5个时伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Envenom or Kingsbane apply Caustic Spatter for 10 sec. Limit 1.

Caustic Spatter causes 20% of your Nature damage dealt to splash onto other nearby enemies, reduced beyond 5 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 锁喉的持续时间延长6秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Garrote lasts 6 sec longer.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使用致命药膏给一件武器浸毒，效果持续1小时。每次攻击都有30%的几率使敌人中毒，并使其在12秒内受到[([11.374% of Attack Power]) * 12 / 2]点自然伤害。随后产生的毒药效果将立即造成([8.14% of Attack Power])点自然伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Coats your weapons with a Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 30% chance to poison the enemy for [(11.374% of Attack Power) * 12 / 2] Nature damage over 12 sec. Subsequent poison applications will instantly deal (8.14% of Attack Power) Nature damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 对生命值低于35%的目标，你的流血、武器药膏和其他自然伤害所造成的伤害会提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Bleed, weapon poison, and other Nature damage is increased by 15% against targets below 35% health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 能量上限提高50点。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases maximum Energy by 50.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你可以为你的武器额外浸毒1种致命和非致命药膏，但其施加几率降低30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: You may apply 1 additional Lethal and Non-Lethal Poison to your weapons, but they have 30% less application chance.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
连击点数的上限额外提高1点。

消耗5点连击点数以上的终结技产生的效果得以加强，并且终结技造成的伤害提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Gain 1 additional max combo point.

Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 施放毒伤时，每消耗一个连击点数就有5%的几率向目标位置投掷一瓶剧毒，形成一滩致命酸液，在2秒内对其中的所有敌人造成[([38.3328% of Attack Power]) * 4]点自然伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Envenom has a 5% chance per combo point spent to smash a vial of poison at the target's location, creating a pool of acidic death that deals [(38.3328% of Attack Power) * 4] Nature damage over 2 sec to all enemies within it.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
挥砍10码范围内的所有敌人，造成([110% of Attack Power])点伤害。超过5个目标后伤害降低。

将你命中的敌人身上持续时间最长的锁喉和割裂复制到最多2名其他敌人身上。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Slash all enemies within 10 yds dealing (110% of Attack Power) damage. Deals reduced damage beyond 5 targets.

Copy the longest Garrote and Rupture on the enemies you hit onto up to 2 other enemies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂徒
影袭会产生1个额外的连击点数（在它触发可乘之机时）。

 奇袭
毁伤、伏击和刀扇有60%的几率产生1个额外的连击点数（在它们触发封印命运时）。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Outlaw
Sinister Strike generates 1 additional combo point when it grants Opportunity.

 Assassination
Mutilate, Ambush, and Fan of Knives have a 60% chance to generate 1 additional combo point when they trigger Seal Fate.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂徒
斩击有4%的几率掷出3个命运硬币。

 奇袭
毒伤有15%的几率掷出3个命运硬币。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Outlaw
Dispatch has a 4% chance to flip 3 Fatebound Coins.

 Assassination
Envenom has a 15% chance to flip 3 Fatebound Coins.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂徒
斩击和正中眉心消耗不低于5点连击点数时，它们的伤害提高5%。

 奇袭
毒伤消耗不低于5点连击点数时，其伤害提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Outlaw
Dispatch and Between the Eyes deal 5% more damage when they consume 5 or more combo points.

 Assassination
Envenom deals 5% more damage when it consumes 5 or more combo points.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂徒
激活冲动会掷出一枚命运硬币并使其竖立，结果同时算作正面和反面。

 奇袭
激活死亡印记会掷出一枚命运硬币并使其竖立，结果同时算作正面和反面。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Outlaw
Activating Adrenaline Rush flips a Fatebound Coin and causes it to land on its edge, counting as both Heads and Tails.

 Assassination
Activating Deathmark flips a Fatebound Coin and causes it to land on its edge, counting as both Heads and Tails.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂徒
通过斩击掷出的命运硬币有33%更高的几率得到和上一次掷出命运硬币时获得相同的结果。

 奇袭
通过毒伤掷出的命运硬币有33%更高的几率得到和上一次掷出命运硬币时获得相同的结果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Outlaw
Fatebound Coins flipped by Dispatch are 33% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.

 Assassination
Fatebound Coins flipped by Envenom are 33% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
每当一个终结技消耗5个或更多连击点数时，掷出一枚命运硬币。正面会使你的攻击伤害提高10%，持续15秒，或直到你掷出反面为止。反面会对被击中的目标造成([168% of Attack Power])点宇宙伤害。

每次你掷出命运硬币的结果与上一次相同时，正面使造成的伤害额外提高2%，反面造成的伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Flip a Fatebound Coin each time a finishing move consumes 5 or more combo points. Heads increases the damage of your attacks by 10%, lasting 15 sec or until you flip Tails. Tails deals (168% of Attack Power) Cosmic damage to your target.

For each time the same face is flipped in a row, Heads increases damage by an additional 2% and Tails increases its damage by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
每投掷7次硬币，就会保留一枚幸运硬币，使你趋向命运，持续12秒。你的敏捷提高4%，命运硬币的伤害和加成效果提高50%，并且硬币投掷结果与上一次相同的几率提高15%。

当你拥有一枚幸运硬币时，投掷硬币不计入寻找幸运硬币的次数。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Every 7 coin flips, keep a lucky coin that bends you towards your fate for 12 sec. Your Agility is increased by 4%, the damage and bonuses of Fatebound Coins are increased by 50%, and coin flips are 15% more likely to match the same face as the last flip.

Coin flips do not count toward finding a lucky coin while you have a lucky coin.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂徒
每次掷出命运硬币时，获得2点能量。硬币立在边缘时，获得10点能量。

 奇袭
每次掷出命运硬币时，获得5点能量。硬币立在边缘时，获得15点能量。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Outlaw
Gain 2 Energy every time you flip a Fatebound Coin. Gain 10 Energy for Coins that land on their edge.

 Assassination
Gain 5 Energy every time you flip a Fatebound Coin. Gain 15 Energy for Coins that land on their edge.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂徒
剑刃乱舞向已受影响的敌人额外施加5%的攻击伤害。

 奇袭
腐蚀飞溅向已受影响的敌人额外施加5%的自然伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Outlaw
Blade Flurry causes an additional 5% of attack damage dealt to be dealt to affected enemies.

 Assassination
Caustic Spatter causes an additional 5% of Nature damage dealt to be dealt to affected enemies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 以命运钱币定夺生死，掷出双面硬币并随硬币正反连续叠加巨额增伤与终结暴击。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Flips fatebound coins with every finisher, stacking massive consecutive bonuses depending on heads or tails outcomes.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你有30%的几率吸收任意所受伤害的10%
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: You have a 30% chance to absorb 10% of any damage taken.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂徒
抓钩可以在3秒内再次使用一次，没有冷却时间，但总的冷却时间延长5秒。

 奇袭
暗影步可以在3秒内再次使用一次，没有冷却时间，但总的冷却时间延长5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Outlaw
Grappling Hook may be used a second time within 3 sec with no cooldown, but its total cooldown is increased by 5 sec.

 Assassination
Shadowstep may be used a second time within 3 sec with no cooldown, but its total cooldown is increased by 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 抛出正面使伤害额外提高4%。抛出反面造成的伤害提高12%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Flipping Heads increases damage by an additional 4%. Damage dealt by flipping Tails is increased by 12%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 爆击几率提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Critical strike chance increased by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在连续抛出4次或更多次相同结果的命运硬币后，下一次抛出的硬币结果将与之相同。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: After flipping a Fatebound Coin that ends a streak of 4 or more, flip another that matches the same face.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在君王之灾命中后，在1秒内快速攻击该目标5次，每次造成([300% of Attack Power])点物理伤害和([207% of Attack Power])点自然伤害。每次攻击都会施加你武器上的致命药膏，并产生一个连击点数。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: After striking with Kingsbane, rapidly strike that target 5 times over 1 sec for (300% of Attack Power) Physical and (207% of Attack Power) Nature damage. Each strike applies the Lethal Poisons on your weapons and generates a combo point.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的自然和流血技能伤害提高10%。
